title: Being poor is expensive. Here's the loop.
caption: Being poor is expensive. No buffer → a surprise becomes a loan → interest eats next month → even less buffer. The first win isn't investing; it's never having to borrow for a surprise.
cta: Follow QuanTik for more dark truths about money

thumb.footer: Simulated / sourced data • Educational, not advice
headline: BEING POOR
IS
EXPENSIVE.

scenes.say: No savings means one broken phone becomes a loan.
The loan costs interest. The interest eats next month's pay.
Next month, there's even less of a cushion.
So the poor pay more for the same things: fees, interest, the cheap boots that break twice.
The way out needs exactly what the trap takes away: time and a buffer.
That's why the first win isn't investing. It's never having to borrow for a surprise.
Poverty isn't a lack of effort. It's a loop that charges interest.

takeaway: Poverty isn't a lack of effort. It's a loop that charges interest.
